industry: Measuring, Medical, Optical and Related Instruments

instrument_device_family.label: Instrument / device family
instrument_device_family.value: Apheresis plasma/blood collection systems, blood management (TEG analyzers, Cell Saver), vascular closure and sensor-guided pressure guidewires

measurement_performance_specification.label: Measurement / performance specification
measurement_performance_specification.value: Higher plasma yield, donor satisfaction and operational efficiency; TEG hemostasis analysis informing treatment decisions; no numeric specifications given

clinical_industrial_research_use.label: Clinical / industrial / research use
clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Hospitals (surgery, cardiology, transfusion), plasma collection centers and blood centers

product_specific_regulatory_status.label: Product-specific regulatory status
product_specific_regulatory_status.value: FDA 510(k)-cleared devices (NexSys PCS, YES technology); VASCADE with EU MDR CE Mark and Japan approval; SavvyWire CE Mark

consumables_service_attachment.label: Consumables / service attachment
consumables_service_attachment.value: Proprietary disposables (plasma collection bowls, TEG cartridges) and software on installed devices; vascular closure devices sold per procedure

notes: Calibration requirements not in evidence; regulatory status varies by product and region.
